title: Axpo’s deployments went from hours to minutes with Octopus - Octopus Deploy
markdown:
![Axpo logo](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/335x128/5eecf6aa8e/axpo-white-logo.svg)

![Requirements clipboard icon](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/67x67/e5d691425f/requirements-icon.svg)

#### Requirements

Automation

Repeatability

Reduce human error

![Company icon](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/67x67/27ba107a3d/company-icon.svg)

#### Company

2500+ employees

![energy, utilities and waste icon](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/64x64/a3dd838d32/renewable-energy-v2.svg)

#### Industry

Energy, Utilities and Waste

> ![Axpo logo image](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/200x76/63e389cfa3/axpo-logo-200.svg)
>
> _The biggest advantage of Octopus is that it elevates deployments and environments and treats them like core features, not something that you force into another tool._

> ![Axpo logo image](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/200x76/63e389cfa3/axpo-logo-200.svg)
>
> _In a large organization like ours, it is important to have a tool that is flexible to the needs of different teams. Octopus is great as each team can integrate it as they need and it works with the tools they use._

![Axpo deployment pipeline](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/1134x432/a90d6e05d2/use-case-axpo.png/m/fit-in/1200x0/filters:quality(85):format(webp))![Axpo deployment pipeline](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/677x494/bdb8673a16/mobile-case-study-axpo.png/m/fit-in/1200x0/filters:quality(85):format(webp))

> ![Axpo logo image](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/200x76/63e389cfa3/axpo-logo-200.svg)
>
> _Before Octopus it was scary to do deployments. We were apprehensive which was why we had monthly release cycles as we had to make sure everything was correct. But with Octopus it’s so refreshingly easy to click a button and feel confident that a deployment will just work._

> ![Axpo logo image](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/200x76/63e389cfa3/axpo-logo-200.svg)
>
> _The great thing about Octopus is that you can do it once and then it’s repeatable. Manual deployments used to take us hours, but now we’re deploying in minutes and more frequently too. Even if a deployment takes longer no one has to sit there to wait for the deployment to run._

> ![Axpo logo image](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/200x76/63e389cfa3/axpo-logo-200.svg)
>
> _From an organizational perspective auditing is very important, so the fact that Octopus has it all right there makes it so much easier for us._
